title: Agile Business Analyst
text: Agile Business Analyst at PM-Partners Group (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). PM-Partners group are a specialist Project Management Consultancy. We have a unique way of running projects and providing training and advice, so our clients get the best results with less cost and risk. Each year we deliver over $2B of projects, train over 9000 people, and help some of Australia’s leading brands improve their PMOs. PM Partners is currently seeking a Senior Agile Business Analyst with experience in the Energy and Utilities space. In order to be successful in this role, you will have an enthusiastic, solutions focused approach. Working with the PM Partners team, you will be responsible for modifications of business systems and interacting with various business stakeholders and subject matter experts in order to understand problems and needs. Your day to day responsibilities will include, but not be limited to: Identifying, evaluating and having a well-defined understanding of the high-level business needs of clients and stakeholders Elicit existing processes and requirements from users and ‘as is’ documentation Analyse and compare ‘as is’ functions with ‘to be’ contractual and user requirements Plan, run and facilitate workshops and elicit requirements using mixtures of workshops and one on one meetings Analyse and document business requirements and write detailed business, stakeholder, functional and non-functional requirements Use data modelling practices to analyse your findings and create usable solutions and suggestions for strategic and operational improvements and changes To be considered for this position you will have experience and strengths in the following: You live and breathe Agile You are a lateral/creative thinker Previous experience as a Business Analyst working on complex Projects or Programs, preferably in a Energy/Utilities environment Excellent stakeholder engagement skills Outstanding analytical, observation and organisational skills Strong written and verbal communication skills If you feel you meet our selection criteria and are looking to join a leading Project Management Consultancy, please submit your resume to Nadine Devine at PM Partners.
